title: AI Chat Assistant - Valid Query Returns Data-Backed Response
description: Verify that when a user submits a valid interior design or pricing query, the AI chat assistant returns a response that references real-time data from the TiDB vector database, ensuring no hallucinations.

steps.description: Open the Home Putra Interior AI web interface and navigate to the AI Chat Assistant section.
Input a valid natural language query regarding interior design options or pricing, for example: 'What is the price for a basic kitchen set with wood finish?'
Submit the query and wait for the AI response.
Verify that the AI response contains specific data points that match current pricing from the TiDB database.
Ensure the AI response is coherent, relevant, and references facts rather than generic or hallucinated information.

title: AI Chat Assistant - Handling Unknown or Unanswerable Queries
description: Verify that when a user submits a query that cannot be answered with available data, the AI chat assistant gracefully informs the user without hallucinations or misleading information.

steps.description: Open the AI Chat Assistant interface.
Submit a question outside the scope of the system, for example: 'Do you offer outdoor furniture consultation?'
Confirm the AI responds politely that the requested information is not available based on current data.
Check that no fabricated answers or hallucinations are present.

title: Product Pricing Catalog - Display Accuracy and Up-to-Date Data
description: Verify that the pricing catalog lists Kitchen Sets, Wallpanels, and Wardrobes with accurate, up-to-date prices and specifications according to the latest data in 'pricing-data.ts'.

steps.description: Navigate to the Product Pricing Catalog page.
Verify that all products (Kitchen Sets, Wallpanels, Wardrobes) are displayed with correct names, specifications, and prices.
Cross-check displayed prices against the current entries in 'pricing-data.ts' for consistency.

title: Product Pricing Catalog - Search and Filter Functionality
description: Verify that the search and filter controls on the pricing catalog work correctly to allow users to find specific products or categories.

steps.description: Access the Product Pricing Catalog page.
Use the search input to look for a Kitchen Set called 'Modern Oak'.
Confirm that relevant products matching the search term are displayed.
Apply a filter for product category 'Wardrobes'.
Check that only Wardrobe items are visible after filtering.
Combine search and filter to refine product list.
Verify that the displayed list matches combined criteria.

title: Proposal Generator - Generate and Copy Quotation
description: Verify that the Proposal Generator converts a consultation chat into a properly formatted quotation that can be copied with one click.

steps.description: Conduct a consultation chat session in the AI Chat Assistant with multiple design and pricing questions.
Use the Proposal Generator feature to create a quotation from the chat context.
Verify that the generated proposal includes accurate pricing and product details matching the chat conversation.
Click the copy button to copy the generated proposal text.
Confirm the copied text matches the displayed proposal content.

title: Material Battle Module - Material Comparison Accuracy
description: Verify that the Material Battle module correctly displays and compares technical aspects of different interior materials.

steps.description: Navigate to the Material Battle module.
Select two different interior materials for comparison.
Check that all relevant technical criteria (e.g., durability, cost, finish) are displayed accurately for both materials.
Confirm the comparison clearly highlights differences and helps users make informed decisions.

title: Rules & Guidelines Panel - Display and Content Verification
description: Verify Rules & Guidelines panel displays policies, shipping information, and FAQs clearly and correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to Rules & Guidelines panel.
Ensure the panel lists operational rules, shipping policies, and FAQs.
Check content readability and correctness against the source documentation.

title: RAG Data Ingestion - Embedding Generation and Database Sync
description: Verify admin script 'setup-rag.ts' processes pricing-data.ts, generates embeddings with Xenova Transformers, and correctly updates the TiDB vector database without errors.

steps.description: Run the admin script 'setup-rag.ts' with sample pricing and product data.
Check that embeddings are generated for all entries without error.
Verify that TiDB vector database is updated with new embeddings.
Confirm that no exceptions or failures occur during ingestion.

title: AI Chat Assistant - Response Performance Under Load
description: Validate that the AI Chat Assistant responds to typical user queries within acceptable performance thresholds under load conditions.

steps.description: Simulate multiple concurrent users querying the AI Chat Assistant with valid design and pricing questions.
Measure response times and ensure average response time is below defined threshold (e.g., 3 seconds).
Confirm responses remain accurate and data-backed under load.

title: Proposal Generator - Handles Empty or Invalid Chat Context
description: Verify that the Proposal Generator handles attempts to generate proposals from empty or invalid chat sessions gracefully with appropriate user feedback.

steps.description: Open Proposal Generator without any prior chat conversation or after clearing chat history.
Attempt to generate a proposal.
Verify the system shows an appropriate message indicating insufficient data to generate a proposal.
Confirm no system crashes or unhandled exceptions occur.
